newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Brash tells Anderton NZ dollar too high.
newsitem.headline: Brash tells Anderton NZ dollar too high.

text.p: Leader of the left-wing Alliance Party, Jim Anderton said on Tuesday he was told in a briefing with Reserve Bank Governor Don Brash that the New Zealand was too high and interest rates too low.
"It seems that private sector adjustments are the order of the day. If you interpret that language. It means recession.
"Well, he has expressed this view before. It is fairly stark. He thinks interest rates are too low. He thinks they should go up. Most of the (Alliance Party) caucus were fairly flabbergasted.
"He thinks the dollar is too high, that the dollar should come down and interest rates will go up," Anderton told reporters.
Brash said after the meeting that he discussed foreign exchange, interest rates and all the things he would be expected to brief the party on. He declined further comment.
